title: ticfac Phase 4: Cloudflare as a compatibility host
description: SPEC §12 Phase 4. Move cloud/factory/** to ticfac/cloudflare/** preserving routes initially; RunWorkflow hosts the reconciler (one Workflow per EpicRun) with tracker access through the contract-held TypeScript implementation (§3.1); repository Durable Object as one-slot lock and serialized publisher; cloud/sandbox/** to ticfac/image/**; cloud/worker/** stays in ticks; run/attempt/decision records move from D1 into .ticfac/ on the run branch pushed on origin at once, D1 as rebuildable index or removed; move Factory credentials, embedding, deployment bundles and CI.
notes:
2026-09-02 13:29 - INHERITED FROM 5hm: see the note on 4ik — items (1) embedded.go bundle pin, (2) required-tk-commands scanner, (3) cloud/worker stays, (4) two binaries and 'tk cloud' -> 'ticfac' repointing all land in this phase when cloud/factory and cloud/sandbox move.
2026-09-17 - MOVED from the ticks tracker to ticfac's own. The ticfac phase ladder was being tracked in ticks under task hzm, which is why ticfac's roadmap showed no Cloudflare work at all. The phases now sit as top-level epics here, alongside qeu (Phase 1), av8 (Phase 2) and 9pd (Phase 3). Nothing in the family referenced anything outside it and no id collided, so the move is the files plus two re-pointings: the parent hzm is dropped, and ncv's blocker becomes 9pd.
2026-09-17 - Blocker re-pointed from ticks tw6 to ticfac 9pd. tw6 ("role jobs, retire Markdown as lifecycle implementation") is still OPEN in ticks and is NOT the same epic as 9pd ("finish the extraction and run it in anger"): tw6 wants review-epic and closeout-epic running as validated role jobs on both executors and the lifecycle loop DELETED from the ticks runner. That work is a genuine prerequisite for Phase 4 and it has not moved here. Decide whether it folds into 9pd, becomes its own ticfac epic, or stays in ticks - do not let the re-pointing quietly drop it.
2026-09-17 21:18 - xo2 is the inventory of what is still in tk and must be ported here rather than deleted: tk cloud spawn/wait/collect/reconcile with internal/cloud, internal/sandbox, internal/wave, plus tk herd and tk sandbox. Those verbs are the only working example of driving Cloudflare worker containers end to end, so they are this phase's reference implementation - port first, prove with this phase's gate, retire after.
acceptance_criteria: Gate: project w1z A1 again — an epic completes unattended and merges its own PR — through the new reconciler, with a Workflow restart mid-run and every in-flight attempt reconciled from .ticfac/.
